Archival Dispatch: 24 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Captains of Industry, Texas Forest Service, and The Karl Morgan Serials

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Captains of Industry, John D Rockefeller, Milton Hershey, Marshall Field, PT Barnum, Texas Forest Service, Sons of the Pioneers, Jelly Elliott, Bill Scott, Karl Morgan, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 59 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 59 resolves 24 historic radio broadcasts across classic American industrial biographical dramas, regional conservation and country Western musical shows, and 1970s satirical serials: 8 foundational episodes from the 1939 docudrama series Captains of Industry (chronicling John D. Rockefeller, Milton Hershey, Marshall Field, P.T. Barnum, Mark Hanna, the Studebaker Brothers, John H. Patterson of NCR, and Frank A. Vanderlip), 8 broadcast conservation programs from the Texas Forest Service / US Forest Service (1950–1952, starring The Sons of the Pioneers as The Singing Woodsman, Jelly Elliott and the Three Knotheads, and Bill Scott, Forest Ranger), and 8 episodes of the satirical radio serial The Karl Morgan Adventures (starring Monte Kessinger and Harriet Greer, 1972).

1. Captains of Industry — 1939 American Business Biography Docudramas

Dramatic portraits of the visionaries who built modern commerce and technology:
